title: Returns and refunds
content: Unused items in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the return arriving. Final-sale items are not returnable.

title: Shipping
content: Standard shipping is EUR 10 and arrives in 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping is EUR 10 and arrives in 1 to 2 business days. Orders ship from Berlin within one business day.

title: Exchanges
content: Sizes can be exchanged once within 30 days of delivery; the replacement ships after the original is received.

title: Order cancellation
content: An order can be cancelled from the account page until it ships. After that, use the returns process.

title: Payment
content: Cards are charged when the order is placed. Test mode: no real charge is made in this lab store.
